company.name: CuspAI
company.shortDescription: CuspAI is a platform that acts as a structured search engine for physical materials discovery.
company.description: CuspAI permits industrial teams to specify desired structural, thermal, or chemical attributes so the system can generate novel, synthesizable molecular structures. Through its integrated computational framework, the technology conducts physics-based molecular simulations to evaluate property fidelity and calculate production routes. The organization coordinates a global ecosystem that connects industrial operators, data suppliers, and validation laboratories to streamline experimental testing.
